ruleset.name: fogwall-metrics
ruleset.description:
Measures complexity (cyclomatic/cognitive/NPath, God Class). Run ad hoc with `./gradlew pmdMetricsAll` (or `:module:pmdMetricsMain`/`pmdMetricsTest`); not part of pmdAll, build, or CI. Stock PMD thresholds — not yet tuned for this codebase.
GodClass false-positives on composition-root / wiring / config classes (e.g. JettyConfigurationBuilder, SecurityConfig): a class whose job is to construct and wire up other objects will score high on ATFD and WMC regardless of DI framework use. Read each hit before acting on it.
